title: Concrete ordinary scalar/reindexing maps before completion
statement: For a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an embedding i:E→L, and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, construct the comparison podCompletedDerivedInverseImage(E,g) followed by completedDerivedScalarExtension(E,L,X) ≅ completedDerivedScalarExtension(E,L,Y) followed by podCompletedDerivedInverseImage(L,g). Identify the two completed inverse-image coefficient maps by their finite quotient projections. Transport the section-normalized ordinary scalar/reindexing comparison through this equality and through the uniquely counit-normalized exact scalar model. For a native realization R on W, also define the native scalar transition as the inverse derived scalar associator followed by native extension of the actual completion map. All maps are concrete composites of the recorded maps, with no existence witness left unspecified.

proof.text: Both coefficient ring maps are the limit lift of the same inverse-image finite projections. Limit hom extensionality identifies them. Apply exact derived localization to equality transport of the module functors.
